project_metadata.title: 青蛙王子與金球
project_metadata.global_style_prompt: Digital storybook illustration, vibrant Pixar style, 3D render feel, rich fairytale mood, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed environments.

protagonist.name: 公主
protagonist.outfit: Elegant pink royal gown with gold embroidery, tiny shiny golden crown.

supporting_characters.name: 國王
supporting_characters.outfit: Majestic red velvet cape, large golden crown.

supporting_characters.name: 王子
supporting_characters.outfit: Handsome royal blue suit with gold trimmings.

character_registry.relationship_dynamics: The Princess initially dislikes the Frog but grows to love his gentle nature. The King is a strict but just father figure. The Prince is the Frog's true form, deeply grateful to the Princess.

environment.location: A grand castle garden with blooming roses.
environment.key_elements: A shiny golden ball in the air, a beautiful stone fountain.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm morning sunlight casting soft shadows, cheerful and peaceful atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 每天早晨，美麗的公主都會在花園裡玩耍。她開心地把最珍貴的金球拋向空中，洋溢著幸福的笑容。
scenes.image_prompt: 公主 is throwing a shiny ball into the air with a bright, joyful smile. Wide shot.

environment.location: An old stone well deep inside the garden.
environment.key_elements: Dark water inside the well, splashing water droplets.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dappled sunlight hitting the stone well, dramatic shadow inside the well.

scenes.narration: 突然，一個不小心，金球從她的手中滑落。撲通一聲，金球掉進了深邃的水井裡，完全消失不見了。
scenes.image_prompt: 公主 is leaning over the stone edge, reaching out desperately toward the bottom. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: Mossy stones, teardrops on the ground.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft lighting focusing on the face, slightly melancholic.

scenes.narration: 失去最愛的玩具，公主坐在井邊難過地大哭起來。這時，耳邊突然響起一個溫和的聲音。
scenes.image_prompt: 公主 is sitting on the ground, wiping tears from her eyes with a sad expression. Close-up shot.

environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright sunlight returning, conveying a feeling of unexpected hope.

scenes.narration: 公主抬起頭，發現是一隻青蛙。青蛙歪著頭說：「我可以幫你撿回金球，但你要答應我一個條件。」
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 青蛙 is sitting on a mossy stone. On the right, 公主 is looking down at him with surprise. Wide shot.

environment.key_elements: The stone edge of the well.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft and warm sunlight, highlighting the interaction.

scenes.narration: 只要能拿回金球，公主什麼都願意。她答應讓青蛙住進城堡，一起吃飯睡覺。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 青蛙 is tilting his head. On the right, 公主 is nodding eagerly while wiping tears. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: The wet golden ball, water droplets.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sparkling water drops catching the sunlight, joyful and vibrant.

scenes.narration: 青蛙立刻跳進井裡，沒多久就把金球叼了上來，輕輕放在公主的面前。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 青蛙 is holding the shiny ball in his mouth. On the right, 公主 is reaching out joyfully. Close-up shot.

environment.location: A stone path leading to the grand castle.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright and airy, conveying a sense of fast movement.

scenes.narration: 公主拿回金球高興極了！她轉身就往城堡跑去，把可憐的青蛙和自己的承諾全都拋在腦後。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 青蛙 is looking sad. On the right, 公主 is running away quickly. Wide shot.

environment.key_elements: Long wooden table with a feast, an open grand wooden door.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm glow from massive crystal chandeliers, dramatic shadows.

scenes.narration: 當晚公主和國王正在吃晚餐，青蛙突然來敲門。國王嚴肅地說：「答應過的事情，就必須履行。」
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 國王 is standing and pointing a finger strictly. On the right, 公主 is looking down guiltily. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: Large bed with silk sheets, fluffy pillows.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool silver moonlight streaming through the window, contrasting with warm bedside lamps.

scenes.narration: 那天晚上，青蛙爬上了公主的枕頭。公主心裡極度不舒服，但也只能無奈地皺著眉頭忍耐。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 青蛙 is resting peacefully. On the right, 公主 is lying down with a highly uncomfortable expression. Close-up shot.

environment.key_elements: Blooming potted flowers, an elegant tea table.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm, pleasant afternoon light, relaxing and harmonious vibe.

scenes.narration: 日子一天天過去，青蛙每天溫柔體貼地陪伴著公主。漸漸地，公主發現自己不再討厭牠了。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 青蛙 is gesturing happily. On the right, 公主 is smiling warmly at him. Wide shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sunset light coming through the window, creating a melancholic mood.

scenes.narration: 有天公主因為好朋友要搬走而傷心大哭。青蛙輕聲安慰：「別怕，我會永遠陪著你。」
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 公主 is covering her face and crying softly. On the right, 青蛙 is looking up at her with concern. Medium shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.key_elements: The armrest of the velvet chair.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm, romantic golden hour lighting focusing on the faces.

scenes.narration: 公主聽了覺得非常幸福，笑著對青蛙說了聲謝謝。接著，她輕輕在青蛙的額頭上吻了一下。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 青蛙 is closing his eyes peacefully. On the right, 公主 is leaning in and gently kissing his forehead. Close-up shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Intense magical glowing light overpowering the sunset, dramatic and miraculous.

scenes.narration: 突然，青蛙的身體閃爍出耀眼的光芒！在不可思議的魔法中，青蛙漸漸變成了一位英俊的王子。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, a bright magical glowing light is bursting. On the right, 公主 is stepping back with wide eyes. Wide shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm and gentle lighting, magical dust slowly settling down.

scenes.narration: 王子溫柔地微笑著，感謝公主的真心一吻解除了巫婆的詛咒。公主驚訝得愣住了，隨後羞澀地笑了。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 王子 is smiling gently. On the right, 公主 is blushing with a shy but happy smile. Medium shot.

environment.location: A grand fairytale wedding courtyard outside a majestic castle.
environment.key_elements: Colorful confetti in the air, a royal carriage.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Extremely bright, festive, and triumphant lighting, pure joy.

scenes.narration: 王子邀請公主回到他的王國一起生活。他們舉行了盛大的婚禮，從此過著幸福快樂的日子。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 王子 is waving joyfully. On the right, 公主 is holding a bouquet and cheering. Wide shot.
